text:
I haven't made an edit, because the outline doesn't show the body of `renderManifest` (lines 778-829). An edit needs search text copied exactly from the file, and I'd only be guessing at the line that counts amendments. A wrong guess would be refused, or would land in the wrong place.

I also need to see that counting line because you asked for the most recent of the amendments *that line counts*. If it counts something other than everything `amendments()` returns, such as only entries since the last reopen, my line has to use the same set. I'd also like to check how `amendments()` (line 681) and `amend()` (line 671) order the log, so "most recent" means the right entry.

Could you paste `renderManifest` (lines 778-829) and `amend` / `amendments` (lines 671-686)? With those I can send a single edit that adds the `Latest: <text> (<by>)` line straight after the count line.
